description: Put a file on Drive byte for byte and prove it: after the upload, Drive's own checksum of what it stored (or the bytes read back, when Drive reports none) is compared with the source's. A difference fails the call and is taken back: a replacement's damaged revision is deleted, a new file is trashed. The file goes as path (a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-76av6nrv); a bare name is taken from the first) or as content_base64 with its sha256. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-76av6nrv), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256. The folder is folder_id, else folder_path, else the root. A name already in the folder is refused unless if_exists says what to do. A file given by path keeps its modification time on Drive. Returns the stored file with its link, size, sha256, md5 and verifiedBy. With convert, an Office file (.docx, .doc, .xlsx, .xls, .csv, .pptx, .ppt) becomes a Google Doc, Sheet or deck instead, named without its extension; a converted file keeps no bytes to compare, so the check is that Drive made the Google type, and the result gives the source's size and sha256 under `source`.

content_base64.description: The bytes as standard base64, only as a script that read the file wrote them, never typed. Needs sha256 and filename.

convert.description: Upload an Office file as the Google Doc, Sheet or deck it converts to. Default false: the bytes as they are.

filename.description: The name on Drive; defaults to the file's (the same key a Gmail attachment takes).

folder_id.description: The destination folder's id. Takes precedence over folder_path.

folder_path.description: The destination folder's path under My Drive; empty is the root.

if_exists.description: A file of that name already there: "fail" (default), "replace" (new revision, same id), or "keep_both".

mime_type.description: Defaults to a guess from the name.

path.description: The file as a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-76av6nrv); a bare name is taken from the first. Links are refused.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file. Required with content_base64, checked with path.

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file to Drive
